tables.name: artifact
tables.description: Compressed archive artifacts with SHA256 deduplication

tables.name: item
tables.description: Archived items with metadata and retention policies

tables.name: event
tables.description: Audit trail for all archive operations

top_20_slowest_queries.description: Search items by repository and tags with metadata filtering
top_20_slowest_queries.query: SELECT i.id, i.path, i.commit_sha, i.metadata FROM item i LEFT JOIN tag t ON i.id = t.item_id WHERE i.repo = $1 AND i.kind = $2 AND t.tag IN ($3, $4, $5) AND i.archived_at > $6 AND i.legal_hold = false GROUP BY i.id HAVING COUNT(t.tag) >= 2 ORDER BY i.archived_at DESC LIMIT 100
top_20_slowest_queries.root_cause: Missing composite index on (repo, kind, archived_at); full scan of tag table; N+1 potential
top_20_slowest_queries.improvement_strategy: Composite index on (repo, kind, archived_at); tag denormalization

top_20_slowest_queries.description: Aggregate events by action type with item relationship join
top_20_slowest_queries.query: SELECT e.action, COUNT(*) as count, MAX(e.created_at) FROM event e JOIN item i ON e.item_id = i.id WHERE e.created_at > $1 AND e.created_at < $2 AND i.repo = $3 GROUP BY e.action ORDER BY count DESC
top_20_slowest_queries.root_cause: No index on event.created_at; join on unindexed item_id; full table scans
top_20_slowest_queries.improvement_strategy: Composite index on (created_at, item_id); partial index for date range

top_20_slowest_queries.description: Find duplicate artifacts by SHA256 and calculate total size
top_20_slowest_queries.query: SELECT content_sha256, COUNT(*) as duplicate_count, SUM(size_bytes) as total_size FROM artifact WHERE created_at > $1 GROUP BY content_sha256 HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ORDER BY total_size DESC LIMIT 50
top_20_slowest_queries.root_cause: No index on created_at; GROUP BY requires full table scan; no covering index
top_20_slowest_queries.improvement_strategy: Composite index on (created_at, content_sha256); covering index

top_20_slowest_queries.description: Find items eligible for deletion based on retention policy
top_20_slowest_queries.query: SELECT i.id, i.path, i.delete_after, i.size_bytes FROM item i WHERE i.delete_after IS NOT NULL AND i.delete_after < NOW() AND i.legal_hold = false AND i.restored_at IS NULL ORDER BY i.delete_after ASC LIMIT 1000
top_20_slowest_queries.root_cause: No index on (delete_after, legal_hold); full scan of 2M rows
top_20_slowest_queries.improvement_strategy: Partial index on (delete_after) WHERE legal_hold = false AND restored_at IS NULL

top_20_slowest_queries.description: Find items by multiple reference types
top_20_slowest_queries.query: SELECT DISTINCT i.id, i.path FROM item i JOIN referent r ON i.id = r.item_id WHERE r.ref_type IN ('PR', 'ISSUE', 'COMMIT') AND r.ref_value IN ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5) ORDER BY i.archived_at DESC LIMIT 100
top_20_slowest_queries.root_cause: No index on (ref_type, ref_value); referent table scan
top_20_slowest_queries.improvement_strategy: Composite index on (ref_type, ref_value); denormalization for common lookups

top_20_slowest_queries.description: Search items by JSON metadata patterns (GIN index candidate)
top_20_slowest_queries.query: SELECT i.id, i.path, i.metadata->'content_type' as type FROM item i WHERE i.metadata @> $1 AND i.kind = $2 AND i.archived_at > $3 ORDER BY i.archived_at DESC LIMIT 500
top_20_slowest_queries.root_cause: GIN index exists but not optimized; no partial index for common patterns
top_20_slowest_queries.improvement_strategy: Add partial GIN index on metadata for active items; add (kind, archived_at) composite

top_20_slowest_queries.description: Calculate storage usage by repository and kind
top_20_slowest_queries.query: SELECT i.repo, i.kind, COUNT(*) as item_count, SUM(a.size_bytes) as total_size, AVG(a.size_bytes) as avg_size FROM item i JOIN artifact a ON i.artifact_id = a.id WHERE i.archived_at > $1 GROUP BY i.repo, i.kind ORDER BY total_size DESC
top_20_slowest_queries.root_cause: No composite index on (repo, kind); join on artifact_id (PK lookup only); GROUP BY on unindexed columns
top_20_slowest_queries.improvement_strategy: Materialized view or pre-aggregated table; composite index on (repo, kind, archived_at)

top_20_slowest_queries.description: Build release component tree with archive lookups
top_20_slowest_queries.query: SELECT rc.id, rc.dest_path, i.path, i.commit_sha FROM release_component rc LEFT JOIN item i ON rc.item_id = i.id WHERE rc.release_id = $1 ORDER BY rc.dest_path ASC
top_20_slowest_queries.root_cause: No index on release_component.release_id; N+1 potential on item lookups
top_20_slowest_queries.improvement_strategy: Index on release_component(release_id); batch load items; denormalization

top_20_slowest_queries.description: Get recent events filtered by action, with item context
top_20_slowest_queries.query: SELECT e.id, e.action, e.actor, e.created_at, i.path, i.repo FROM event e JOIN item i ON e.item_id = i.id WHERE e.action = $1 AND e.created_at > $2 ORDER BY e.created_at DESC LIMIT 500
top_20_slowest_queries.root_cause: No index on (action, created_at); item lookup for each event
top_20_slowest_queries.improvement_strategy: Composite index on (action, created_at); denormalize item path/repo into event

top_20_slowest_queries.description: Find most common tags and their cardinality
top_20_slowest_queries.query: SELECT t.tag, COUNT(t.item_id) as cardinality, COUNT(DISTINCT i.repo) as repo_count FROM tag t JOIN item i ON t.item_id = i.id GROUP BY t.tag ORDER BY cardinality DESC LIMIT 100
top_20_slowest_queries.root_cause: No indexes on tag columns; full join scan; GROUP BY on tag string
top_20_slowest_queries.improvement_strategy: Materialized view; composite index on (tag, item_id)

top_20_slowest_queries.description: Audit items restored from archive with history
top_20_slowest_queries.query: SELECT i.id, i.path, i.restored_at, COUNT(e.id) as event_count FROM item i LEFT JOIN event e ON i.id = e.item_id WHERE i.restored_at IS NOT NULL AND i.restored_at > $1 GROUP BY i.id ORDER BY i.restored_at DESC LIMIT 200
top_20_slowest_queries.root_cause: No index on (restored_at); LEFT JOIN on event creates cartesian product risk
top_20_slowest_queries.improvement_strategy: Partial index on restored_at; pre-aggregate event counts

top_20_slowest_queries.description: Calculate compression efficiency by MIME type
top_20_slowest_queries.query: SELECT a.mime_type, a.compression, COUNT(*) as count, SUM(a.size_bytes) as original_size, SUM(octet_length(a.blob_bytes)) as compressed_size FROM artifact a WHERE a.blob_bytes IS NOT NULL GROUP BY a.mime_type, a.compression ORDER BY (1.0 - SUM(octet_length(a.blob_bytes))::float / SUM(a.size_bytes)) DESC
top_20_slowest_queries.root_cause: Full table scan; no indexes on mime_type/compression; blob_bytes scan expensive
top_20_slowest_queries.improvement_strategy: Materialized view; separate table for compression stats; exclude blob from scan

top_20_slowest_queries.description: Compare components between two releases
top_20_slowest_queries.query: SELECT rc1.dest_path FROM release_component rc1 WHERE rc1.release_id = $1 EXCEPT SELECT rc2.dest_path FROM release_component rc2 WHERE rc2.release_id = $2 ORDER BY dest_path
top_20_slowest_queries.root_cause: No index on release_id; EXCEPT requires full scans; no optimization
top_20_slowest_queries.improvement_strategy: Index on release_id; use CTE for better optimization; consider ETL approach

top_20_slowest_queries.description: Find items where artifact is missing (referential integrity check)
top_20_slowest_queries.query: SELECT i.id, i.path, i.artifact_id FROM item i WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM artifact a WHERE a.id = i.artifact_id) LIMIT 100
top_20_slowest_queries.root_cause: NOT EXISTS with subquery; artifact_id scan inefficient for anti-join
top_20_slowest_queries.improvement_strategy: Add CHECK constraint; use LEFT JOIN with IS NULL instead of NOT EXISTS

top_20_slowest_queries.description: Detect items with outdated metadata schema versions
top_20_slowest_queries.query: SELECT i.id, i.metadata->'schema_version' as version, COUNT(*) as count FROM item i WHERE i.metadata->'schema_version' IS NOT NULL AND i.metadata->>'schema_version' < '2.0' GROUP BY i.metadata->>'schema_version' ORDER BY version ASC
top_20_slowest_queries.root_cause: GIN index scan with casting; GROUP BY on JSON string comparison
top_20_slowest_queries.improvement_strategy: Add generated column for schema_version; regular index on generated column

top_20_slowest_queries.description: Export all events for a date range in batches
top_20_slowest_queries.query: SELECT e.id, e.item_id, e.action, e.actor, e.context, e.created_at FROM event e WHERE e.created_at >= $1 AND e.created_at < $2 ORDER BY e.created_at, e.id LIMIT 10000
top_20_slowest_queries.root_cause: No index on created_at; large LIMIT needs full scan; context JSONB expensive
top_20_slowest_queries.improvement_strategy: Composite index on (created_at, id); covering index excluding context

top_20_slowest_queries.description: Build transitive closure of references
top_20_slowest_queries.query: WITH RECURSIVE ref_graph AS (SELECT item_id, ref_value FROM referent WHERE ref_type = 'PARENT' UNION ALL SELECT r.item_id, r.ref_value FROM referent r JOIN ref_graph g ON r.ref_value = g.item_id) SELECT DISTINCT item_id FROM ref_graph
top_20_slowest_queries.root_cause: Recursive CTE without proper indexing; potentially expensive transitive closure
top_20_slowest_queries.improvement_strategy: Index on (ref_type, ref_value); consider materialized transitive closure table

top_20_slowest_queries.description: Find artifacts not referenced by any item
top_20_slowest_queries.query: SELECT a.id, a.size_bytes FROM artifact a WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM item i WHERE i.artifact_id = a.id) ORDER BY a.created_at DESC LIMIT 1000
top_20_slowest_queries.root_cause: Artifact scan with anti-join; no partial index for optimization
top_20_slowest_queries.improvement_strategy: Partial index on artifact for created_at; maintain artifact_ref_count

top_20_slowest_queries.description: Autocomplete suggestions for tag search
top_20_slowest_queries.query: SELECT DISTINCT t.tag FROM tag t WHERE t.tag LIKE $1 ORDER BY t.tag LIMIT 50
top_20_slowest_queries.root_cause: LIKE pattern matching without trigram index; DISTINCT on 8M rows
top_20_slowest_queries.improvement_strategy: Add trigram index (pg_trgm); denormalize into separate tag vocabulary table; cache

top_20_slowest_queries.description: Find all releases for a given release family
top_20_slowest_queries.query: SELECT rm.id, rm.version, rm.created_at FROM release_meta rm WHERE rm.release_id LIKE $1 ORDER BY rm.created_at DESC
top_20_slowest_queries.root_cause: No index on release_id; LIKE pattern matching; small dataset but repeated query
top_20_slowest_queries.improvement_strategy: Index on release_id; consider splitting into release_family and version tables

n_plus_one_lookups.mitigation: Denormalization or batch loading; hash joins via proper indexing

json_metadata_scans.primary_cause: GIN index suboptimal; no partial indexes for common patterns
json_metadata_scans.mitigation: Generated columns; regular indexes on extracted fields

aggregation_without_index.primary_cause: GROUP BY on unindexed columns; no materialized views
aggregation_without_index.mitigation: Materialized views; pre-aggregated tables; covering indexes

large_resultset_handling.primary_cause: Large LIMIT without proper pagination support
large_resultset_handling.mitigation: Index on sort column; cursor-based pagination; connection pooling

recursive_expensive_operations.primary_cause: Recursive CTEs or expensive set operations without index support
recursive_expensive_operations.mitigation: Materialized closure tables; iterative instead of recursive

string_pattern_matching.mitigation: Trigram indexes (pg_trgm); separate vocabulary tables; caching

cache_read_heavy_queries.reason: Tags change infrequently; high read volume

denormalization_candidates.current_pattern: item LEFT JOIN tag; item JOIN event
denormalization_candidates.denormalization_option: Store tag_count, recent_tags in item table
Denormalize item.path, item.repo into event table
